sqliteSql: SELECT month_key,CASE WHEN COUNT(*) OVER(ORDER BY month_key ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)=3 THEN ROUND(100.0*SUM(expense_cents) OVER(ORDER BY month_key ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)/NULLIF(SUM(net_cents) OVER(ORDER BY month_key ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW),0),2) END AS pct FROM cost_series ORDER BY month_key
